caption:
She folded a paper crane and flew it home.
Seedance 2.5 painted every rain-soaked frame.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 2:1 ultra-wide cinematic frame (1280x646). Look: cinematic 2.5D painterly animation, like gouache concept-art paintings in motion: visible brush texture on skin, cloth and buildings, soft posterized color blocks with hard-edged light shapes, matte finish, soft volumetric light, shallow depth of field. Not flat 2D cartoon, no black outlines, no cel-shading, not glossy CGI, no photorealism. Color: rainy night city in magenta-pink and cyan neon with deep blue-violet shadows for the first 23 seconds; warm golden tungsten lamplight on the final balcony. Camera feel: intimate macro inserts and close-ups on the rooftop, a fast FPV flight through the city, calm locked-off framing at the end. Pacing: quick 2-second shots building to the flight, then a slow, tender ending. No on-screen text, no logos, no subtitles.

CHARACTERS:
- NIA: young night courier, about 18, slim and athletic, warm light-brown skin, big expressive amber-brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, messy shaggy black hair with spiky bangs over her forehead that the wind blows into wild curls in flight. Wears an oversized mustard-yellow rain jacket with a high collar, a hood down on her back and big dark buttons, a dark crossbody bag strap across her chest, black fingerless gloves, dark navy cuffed trousers and chunky white sneakers. Signature: the mustard-yellow raincoat and black fingerless gloves in every shot.
- MASTER ODA: elderly retired paper-folder, about 80, slightly stooped, pale weathered skin, swept-back silver-white hair, bushy white eyebrows, round thin-rimmed glasses, kind face. Wears a soft grey knitted cardigan over a white collared shirt, brown trousers and brown slippers. Signature: round glasses and grey cardigan.
- THE CRANE: a small origami crane folded from glossy mustard-yellow paper, crisp sharp creases.

LOCATIONS:
- THE ROOFTOP: a wet, dark flat city rooftop at night in light rain, shallow puddles reflecting neon, a glowing pink neon sign and a cyan-lit window behind, metal vents and boxes, a small dark delivery scooter with a cargo box on the back. Beyond: a dense skyline of tall dark skyscrapers in blue rain haze.
- THE BALCONY: a narrow balcony on an old dark brick apartment building, black wrought-iron railing with round loops, warm wet tiles, an open doorway into a room whose walls are covered in golden wallpaper patterned with rows of tiny paper cranes, glowing amber.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.5) — Splash. Low ground-level close-up, camera locked just above the wet rooftop and tracking slowly back: Nia's chunky white sneakers and navy trouser cuffs stride toward camera through a shallow neon puddle, a sneaker sole stomping down and throwing up a splash; pink and cyan neon reflected in the water, the scooter's dark wheel at frame left, light rain.
SHOT 2 (00:01.5-00:03.8) — The fold. Macro insert, front view: her two hands in black fingerless gloves, yellow sleeve cuffs visible, fold a small square of yellow paper into a triangle, then pinch and pull it into the neck and wings of a small paper crane; sharp creases catch a magenta rim light; blurred purple stormy sky behind.
SHOT 3 (00:03.8-00:05.75) — The window. Medium close-up from the side: Nia in her yellow raincoat looks down, sad and tired, rain falling; the camera drifts behind her shoulder into an over-the-shoulder view of the distant skyline: rows of tall dark skyscrapers in blue rain haze, and in the middle one tower with a single tiny warm orange lit window near its top. MUST SHOW: the one small glowing orange window in the dark tower, center frame.
SHOT 4 (00:05.75-00:07.9) — Grounded. Medium shot, front view, locked-off: Nia sits astride the small dark delivery scooter, its round mirror and headlight in the foreground, the bright pink neon sign behind her; she scowls and slams her gloved palm down on the handlebar; the scooter stays dead.
SHOT 5 (00:07.9-00:10.1) — The breath. Close-up of her face, slight low angle: a frustrated frown, her brows knit; she glances down, her eyes widen with an idea, she lifts the tiny yellow paper crane to her lips and blows a warm breath over it; the crane glows soft gold and lights her cheeks and nose warm orange. MUST SHOW: the small crane glowing gold at her lips.
SHOT 6 (00:10.1-00:12.2) — Unfolding. Her fingertips hold the small crane up at the bottom of the frame against the grey stormy sky; it flutters free and hovers in the air, wings spread wide, rain droplets beading in a row along the wings, and it grows and grows; it ends as a close view from behind and below of a giant paper crane whose broad yellow wings fill the frame. MUST SHOW: the crane growing from palm-size to giant, with rain beads on its wings.
SHOT 7 (00:12.2-00:12.4) — Snap. Two split-second flash cuts of the giant yellow paper wings snapping fully open, crisp creases.
SHOT 8 (00:12.4-00:14.25) — Lift off. Wide low-angle front view of the rooftop edge against magenta-purple neon haze and the dark skyline: Nia stands on the edge holding the giant paper crane above her head like a hang-glider, a wide triangle of yellow paper wings on a thin dark frame, her raincoat flaring, the scooter's silhouette at frame left; she leaps forward and glides out, hanging face-down beneath the paper wings as it sweeps low past the camera, leaving the empty purple sky.
SHOT 9 (00:14.25-00:15.9) — The dive. Fast FPV shot from the glider's point of view, diving steeply down between dark glass skyscrapers with lit windows toward glowing neon signs and a bright yellow billboard far below, rain streaking past.
SHOT 10 (00:15.9-00:17.7) — Neon run. Fast FPV dash, swooping right past a huge glowing purple-pink neon sign, then weaving between cyan- and magenta-lit towers, a pink neon strip flashing by close to the lens.
SHOT 11 (00:17.7-00:19.96) — Laughing. Medium close-up, front view, camera flying just ahead of her: Nia hangs under the glider, both gloved hands gripping the horizontal control bar, the yellow paper wing above her and the frame's diagonal struts beside her head, her hair blown into wild curls; she grins, then laughs wide-eyed and open-mouthed; her fingertips start to glow bright paper-white with a soft white outline. Neon city blurs behind. MUST SHOW: the glowing white fingertips on the bar.
SHOT 12 (00:19.96-00:20.8) — The tear. Extreme macro on the edge of a yellow paper wing, rain streaking across it; the soaked fibers soften and a small crease rips open along the edge.
SHOT 13 (00:20.8-00:21.83) — Hold on. Close-up: her gloved fist clenches the wet edge of the yellow paper wing tightly, rain flying past, blue city light behind.
SHOT 14 (00:21.83-00:23.2) — The approach. Wide shot: the small yellow glider sails past a big glowing cyan-and-white billboard on a building, then descends toward the dark wall of an old brick apartment building with a warm lit window and balcony.
SHOT 15 (00:23.2-00:24.1) — Landing. Low floor-level shot on the warm wet balcony tiles, iron railing and rainy night at left: Master Oda's slippered feet and brown trousers stand still at frame right; Nia's white sneakers drop into frame and land with a small splash, her yellow raincoat hem swinging down behind them.
SHOT 16 (00:24.1-00:27.1) — The gift. Medium close-up of Master Oda, crane-patterned golden wallpaper and the doorway behind him: Nia's black-gloved hand reaches in from frame right and places a small yellow paper crane in his open palm; his eyebrows rise and his mouth opens in surprise; then he lifts it gently in both hands, looks at it closely, and his face melts into a soft, teary, tender smile.
SHOT 17 (00:27.1-00:30.1) — Home. Wide, locked-off from outside the balcony at night, the black wrought-iron railing with round loops across the foreground: the two stand facing each other in near-silhouette against the glowing golden doorway and crane-patterned wall, Master Oda stooped at left holding the paper crane, Nia in her yellow raincoat at right; a few tiny paper cranes flutter up and circle in the warm light above them. Hold until the end.

SOUND: gentle emotional orchestral score with soft piano and strings, building into a soaring theme during the flight (SHOTS 8-11) and settling back to soft piano for the balcony. Steady rain throughout. SHOT 1: wet sneaker splash. SHOT 2: crisp paper creasing. SHOT 4: a hard slap on the handlebar, Nia's annoyed huff. SHOT 5: a soft breath and a faint warm shimmer. SHOT 6: paper fluttering and rustling, growing louder. SHOT 8: a big whoosh of paper wings. SHOTS 9-10: rushing wind and rain, a distant neon hum. SHOT 11: Nia's joyful laugh. SHOT 12: a small paper rip. SHOT 15: a light splash on the tiles. SHOT 16: Master Oda's soft surprised breath. SHOT 17: faint rustle of tiny paper wings. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Painterly 2.5D gouache animation, rainy neon city: a young courier in a mustard-yellow raincoat breathes on a paper crane, it grows into a glider, she soars between neon towers and lands on an old man's warm balcony to hand him the crane. Tender, magical.
